name: v82_fast_editorial_qmb_calm
hypothesis: Fast editorial/commentary stance may capture opinion-driven information that is distinct from earnings, M&A, credit, legal, and generic fast sentiment if filtered by lower story noise and calmer beta.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_relevance_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: New qmb/editorial vector route; reject if it maps to e7OQoveE/Vkp0P130 fast-news capacity.

name: v82_fast_editorial_positive_relevance
hypothesis: Unlike low-relevance generic fast news, editorial commentary may work better when the story is clearly attached to the company.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_event_relevance_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.22 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_60_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Relevance sign ablation; no generic ssc/qep, no earnings/M&A/credit/legal terms.

name: v82_editorial_matrix_fast_confirm
hypothesis: The sparse fast editorial vector may need confirmation from the slower mean editorial-commentary matrix to avoid one-day noise.
expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.28 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_editorial_commentary_sentiment, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_60_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Combines qmb fast vector with a same-theme matrix field rather than generic fast sentiment.

name: v82_editorial_social_stability
hypothesis: Editorial/commentary stance may be more investable when social sentiment is stable and negative buzz is fading, while keeping social terms small enough not to become JjpPv3N2.
expression: 0.36 * group_rank(ts_rank(vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(mean_editorial_commentary_sentiment, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_std_dev(scl12_sentiment_fast_d1, 20), 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * snt_buzz_ret_fast_d1, 126), industry) + 0.14 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (correlation_last_90_days_spy - correlation_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Small social-stability sleeve only; strict corr gate vs JjpPv3N2 and e7OQoveE.

name: v82_editorial_contrarian_lownoise
hypothesis: If editorial/commentary tone is crowded or overreactive, fading positive commentary under low story count may be the better sign.
expression: 0.42 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(nws18_qmb_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * mean_editorial_commentary_sentiment, 126), industry) + 0.18 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * vec_avg(story_event_record_count_fast_d1), 90), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Sign-control for editorial/commentary; stop the route if both signs are weak or high-corr.
